remarks: Welcome Home! This 1880 sq/ft home sits on large premier corner lot (corner of Dorrance and Maple with driveway on Maple) with huge extra long detached 2 car garage, shed, and Generac generator. Currently layed out as a two family home and is a two family home on tax records- however this home was owner occupied and lived in as a single family home for a long time by prior owners. Endless options, live in one unit and rent out the other, make a huge single family home, or collect rent from two tenants. The lower features a beautiful kitchen with custom oak cabinets and granite countertops. There is one large bedroom that could potentially be two bedrooms. There is a huge full bath with double sink and also a massive living room. The second floor has 2 bedrooms, full bath, kitchen, and living room. The attic has walkup stairs and could potentially be added space to use. All windows are in great, most of them newer condition. The boiler is a Dunkirk boiler and in phenomenal condition as is the newer hot water tank. The home has circuit breakers connected to an automatic transfer switch for generator. There is also a subpanel for electric in the garage. Offers are reviewed as received. Also listed as a single family residence, MLS B1706481.
